start: Any page of the panel, signed in as owner; three alerts wait, two of them new

steps.action: Look at the bell at the top
user_sees: A number on the bell; its label reads 'Notifications, 3 waiting for you'
must_not: A number that counts handled lines
A line that belongs to another gym or branch

steps.action: Tap the bell
user_sees: A panel with the group 'Your gym' first, then 'From MettleUp' and 'What's new' when they have something
The two new lines carry a 'New' tag
'History' at the top
must_not: A group heading with nothing under it (other than Your gym)
Lines moving while the panel is open

steps.action: Tap a line that needs someone (a member message)
user_sees: The panel closes and the page of that line opens
must_not: The line leaves the bell just because it was opened

steps.action: Handle it in its page and open the bell again
user_sees: The line is no longer in the main list; History shows it with the tag 'Done'
The number on the bell is one lower
must_not: The line still counted on the bell
The line missing from History

start: Any page, signed in as owner; nothing waits and nothing happened in the last 7 days

steps.action: Tap the bell
user_sees: Under 'Your gym': 'Nothing is waiting for you. New messages and requests from your members will show here.'
The bell's label is just 'Notifications' (no number)
must_not: A blank panel
A zero shown as a number on the bell

steps.action: Open 'History'
user_sees: 'Nothing here yet. What you finish or remove shows here for 7 days.'
must_not: An error
Lines older than 7 days

steps.action: The server sends an answer the panel cannot read
user_sees: The bell keeps what it showed before (what exactly: unknown, not read in code)
must_not: The panel crashes
Every old alert suddenly counts as new

start: The bell panel is open, signed in as owner; one news line and one line that needs someone

steps.action: Tap the X on the line that needs someone
user_sees: The line leaves the list at once; a bar says 'Removed from your list.' with 'Undo' for about 7 seconds
must_not: The thing itself is marked done
The line disappears for other people at the gym

steps.action: Tap 'Undo'
user_sees: The line is back in its place by time
must_not: Two copies of the line
The line comes back as new

steps.action: Tap the X again, wait for the bar to go, open History
user_sees: The line is on top with the tag 'Removed · Not done yet'
must_not: The tag says 'Done'
The line is missing from History

steps.action: Tap the news line (a member joined)
user_sees: Its page opens; next time the bell opens the line is in History with the tag 'Opened'
must_not: News stays in the main list after it was opened
The number on the bell still counts it

steps.action: While the panel is open, someone else handles another line on another device
user_sees: That line stays where it was and gets a 'Done' tag in place; nothing new is slipped in until the panel opens again
must_not: Lines jump under the finger
A handled line with no tag

start: The bell, signed in as owner; another way in: History, and another kind: a payment line

steps.action: Open the bell and tap 'History'
user_sees: 'The last 7 days: what was done, opened or removed. Tap a line to open it.' and the lines, newest change first, each with a tag (Done, Opened, Removed, Older than 7 days)
must_not: A line with no tag
An action line removed but not done tagged 'Done'

steps.action: Tap a History line
user_sees: Its page opens
must_not: Nothing happens
The line moves back to the main list

steps.action: A member pays online; open the bell
user_sees: The line has the payment colour, a mark and the label 'Payment'
must_not: A line that says a payment failed shown as 'Paid'
Colour as the only sign (no label)

start: Two people of one gym, each on their own device; this one is the owner

steps.action: This person removes a line with the X
user_sees: It leaves only this person's list
must_not: It leaves the other person's bell
It is marked done for the gym

steps.action: This person opens the bell (the new lines become read)
user_sees: The number drops only on this person's devices
must_not: The other person's new lines become read

steps.action: A member sends a complaint; the owner opens the bell
user_sees: The complaint line is in the owner's bell
must_not: The complaint text or a phone number in the line
